newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $103/dressed, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $103/dressed, light - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, although market not fully established on a live basis, USDA said. Buyer interest good, seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs few 63.00-64.00; Dressed basis mostly 102.00, few 103.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs few 62.00; Dressed basis 101.00-102.00, few 100.00.
